title: HB1596 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 38, Chapter 6 and Section 39-17-1316, relative to the transfer of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-02-14; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2927903)
provenance.note: Draft of 2024-02-14 (as introduced); amendments not in text. Caption also mentions Title 38, Chapter 6, but no section in the text amends it. Senate twin is SB 2961.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1316(c)): (2) Except with respect to transactions between persons licensed as dealers under 18 U.S.C. § 923, a gun dealer shall not deliver a firearm to a purchaser until fifteen (15) business days after compliance with subdivision (c)(1).
SECTION 1 (short title): This act is known and may be cited as the "Gun Purchase Waiting Period Act."
